rows.en: Yeah, yeah, you looked super cute!
rows.notes: Female only; answers Hoshimura's 'did it look good on me?'.

rows.en:
You've been getting close with that guy
lately, huh... I heard the rumors...
rows.notes: ext_yui_005, both genders. 'Ano otoko no hito' is not named.

rows.en: Akimizu!
Akimizu, what are you doing in the schoolyard?

Um, I'm carrying some materials the teacher
asked me to take to the classroom.
Which classroom?
Ours, of course.
Then why are you in the schoolyard?
Hmm, why am I?
(Is Akimizu kind of an airhead?)
Ahaha, I'd better get to the classroom...

H-hey, wait!
The classroom's not that way!
Isn't it?
...Akimizu, you're an operator, right...?

Yes, I am.
Why do you ask?

Can you really direct missions when you've
got no sense of direction?
No sense of direction? Who?
...You, Akimizu.

No way, that's so silly!
Oh, stop it!
Now I'm getting worried...

Ahahaha...
But really, I'm fine.
I can read the data... and I call things out...
(...I bet everyone around her is worried sick!)
rows.notes: Both genders; inner thought about Yuu.

rows.en: Well, I'll get going.
Bye-bye.
rows.notes: x10: Akimizu here, Claire in frd_cla_102/105.

rows.en: (Akimizu... I'm worried about her...)
Yuu!
Yuu, what are you doing in the schoolyard?
(Is Yuu kind of an airhead?)
...Yuu, you're an operator, right...?
...You, Yuu.

Ahahaha...
I'm totally fine.
Well, I'll get going!
(Yuu... Is she going to be okay...?)
(Swimming today, huh~)

(Oh, it's Akimizu... So the girls are
with us today too.)
Now that's... a fine view...
G-Gary-sensei, when did you get here...?

Since about when you started making eyes
at Akimizu.
rows.notes: Both genders (also said to the female player).

rows.en:
I-I was not!
Don't say weird stuff like that!!
Don't be shy, don't be shy...

Akimizu's got that innocent face, and then
she's got *that*... If I were ten years younger,
I'd make a move on her myself...
rows.notes: Both genders; Gary means her figure ('are').

rows.en:
That's rude to Akimizu, and that's not
something a teacher should be saying...
What about me?
A-Akimizu!!
Hm? What's wrong? You look flustered...
'...Looks like she didn't hear.'
rows.notes: Both genders. Whispered aside in double corner brackets: kept as single quotes.

rows.en: 'Looks like it...'
rows.notes: Both genders; whispered aside, as c03654.

rows.en:
Hee hee...
You and Gary-sensei sure are close.

N-no, we're not!!
Who'd ever be close with Gary-sensei...
You don't have to deny it! That kinda hurts!
You two are so close~

Tch!
Quit slacking off, you two, and swim properly!
Goodbye, Gary-sensei.
A-are you taking a break, Akimizu?
Yeah... I got a little tired.
Oh, I see...
rows.notes: x5: ext_yuu_002 both genders, nml_kgr_005 female, nml_myk_010 both genders.

rows.en:
(Akimizu in a swimsuit... You can't tell
when she's in uniform, but wow, this is...)
...Is something wrong?
(If she gets th-that close...!)
N-nothing, it's nothing...

Your face is red...
Do you have a fever or something?

Wh-whoaaa!!
I'm fine, really!!
You don't have to touch me!!
You're acting weird, \p-kun...
(Being that oblivious is downright dangerous!!)
rows.notes: Male only ('mujikaku': unaware of her own appeal).

rows.en:
W-well, I'm gonna go swim!
See you!
Okay, see you...
(Phew, that was close...)
(Oh, it's Yuu... Her figure's as great as ever...)

Saying stuff like that... It's rude to Yuu, and
that's not something a teacher should say...
Y-Yuu!!

N-no, we're not!!
As if I'd be close with Gary-sensei of all people...

You don't have to deny it that hard!
That kinda hurts!
Hehe, you two are so close~
Taking a break, Yuu?

(Akimizu in a swimsuit...
Even to another girl, she's... whoa...)
rows.notes: Female only; the Japanese uses her surname here.

rows.en:
I'm fine, really!!
You don't have to touch me!!
You're acting weird, \p-chan...
(Being that oblivious is downright dangerous!!)

W-well, I'm gonna go swim!
See you!

c03654/c03655: whispered asides marked with double corner brackets in the Japanese; rendered in single quotes.
c03629: Akimizu's 'koe kaketeru shi' rendered 'I call things out' (she talks the pilots through).
